The '''Tidal Circuit''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperroute]] running a course through much of [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The route originated at [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and terminated at the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]].
